summary: Confirmed $32-42. Added 50A, pull-through, dump/showers, April 1-Nov 1 season, booking engine. --AWH note kept verbatim.
flags: RATE vs --AWH note: note says 'Cheap ($25-35)'; the operator's 2026 rate is $32-42 (lake front to $52 Fri/Sat). Note kept verbatim as told; fees carry the current figures.
GOOGLE: 4.8 from 408 reviews. Gate passes: cheapest RV night $32. No gateway. Good Sam directory has no listing within ~5 km, status unknown.

PRESENCE: own site with posted rates and a booking engine. Rig-road caution, review read (2 months ago): 'The road to get here is way to narrow and has no shoulder. We would not be comfortable pulling a 35 ft trailer to get here.' The engine recommends entering from Tunnel Hill Road.

PIN: stored 38.3146,-86.4801 is the lodge/office, about 370 m N of the main RV rows. Suggested about 38.3113,-86.4803, the full-utility rows (read off imagery at 1 m/px, an estimate). River sites 201-217 are near 38.3098,-86.4825.

WATER: 'riverfront' looks supported. River sites 201-217 (water + electric, all nightly per the camping page and map) are along the Little Blue River on the map and imagery, though I could not measure apron width under canopy. Deer Lake (pond) sites 142-147 lake view and 150 lake front are full-utility.
OWNERSHIP: 'private' holds in practice but the operator is a nonprofit, The Clayton Roberson Family Foundation, Inc. No seasonal rate found. No alcohol allowed.
COUNT: 64 stored, no page states a total ('Over 30' full-utility + 17 river sites + others on the map). Left.
